business_summary: Inter Action Corporation engages in the development, manufacturing, and sells inspection illuminators for applications in imaging semiconductor manufacturing processes in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Internet of Things Related Business; and Promotion Business of Industry 4.0. It offers image sensor inspection light source devices and pupil lens modules for manufacturing CCD and CMOS image sensors. In addition, it provides precision vibration isolation systems that protect precision equipment; and gear testing systems to gear manufacturers. Inter Action Corporation was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.
